reports.title: What this dashboard is for
reports.query:
# Kitchen sink

Every report and parameter type NeoDash 2.4 supports, on the mock retail dataset. Use it to compare the legacy and rebuilt UIs page by page.

| Page | Covers |
|---|---|
| Basics | markdown, single value, table, raw JSON, iframe |
| Charts | bar (grouped, stacked, horizontal), line, pie, radar, gauge |
| Hierarchies & flows | treemap, sunburst, circle packing, Sankey |
| Geo | point map, map with lanes, choropleth, area map |
| Graphs | 2D graph, 3D graph, movies graph, Gantt |
| Parameters | every parameter-select type, multi-select |

reports.title: Product catalogue
reports.query:
MATCH (p:Product)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(sub:Category)-[:SUBCATEGORY_OF]->(top:Category)
RETURN p.sku AS SKU, p.name AS Product, top.name AS Category, sub.name AS Subcategory, p.price AS Price, p.stock AS Stock, p.rating AS Rating, p.launched AS Launched
ORDER BY SKU

reports.title: Raw result (one order)
reports.query:
MATCH (cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order {id: 'O-1'})-[c:CONTAINS]->(p:Product)
RETURN cu {.id, .name, .segment} AS customer, o {.*, date: toString(o.date)} AS order, collect(p.name) AS products

reports.title: Revenue by category and segment (grouped)
reports.query:
MATCH (cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[c:CONTAINS]->(:Product)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(:Category)-[:SUBCATEGORY_OF]->(top:Category)
WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'
RETURN top.name AS Category, cu.segment AS Segment, toInteger(sum(c.quantity * c.unitPrice)) AS Revenue
ORDER BY Category

reports.title: Orders by year and channel (horizontal, stacked)
reports.query:
MATCH (o:Order)
RETURN toString(o.date.year) AS Year, o.channel AS Channel, count(o) AS Orders
ORDER BY Year

reports.title: Monthly revenue by channel (multi-series)
reports.query:
MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.status <> 'Cancelled'
WITH date.truncate('month', o.date) AS Month, o.channel AS channel, sum(o.total) AS revenue
WITH Month, collect([channel, revenue]) AS pairs
RETURN Month,
       toInteger(coalesce([p IN pairs WHERE p[0] = 'Web' | p[1]][0], 0)) AS `Web`,
       toInteger(coalesce([p IN pairs WHERE p[0] = 'Mobile' | p[1]][0], 0)) AS `Mobile`,
       toInteger(coalesce([p IN pairs WHERE p[0] = 'Store' | p[1]][0], 0)) AS `Store`,
       toInteger(coalesce([p IN pairs WHERE p[0] = 'Partner' | p[1]][0], 0)) AS `Partner`
ORDER BY Month

reports.title: Category health
reports.query:
MATCH (top:Category)<-[:SUBCATEGORY_OF]-(:Category)<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(p:Product)<-[c:CONTAINS]-(o:Order)
WITH top.name AS category,
     100.0 * sum(c.quantity * (c.unitPrice - p.cost)) / sum(c.quantity * c.unitPrice) AS margin,
     avg(p.rating) * 20 AS rating,
     100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.onTime THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(o) AS onTime,
     1000.0 * sum(CASE WHEN o.status = 'Returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(o) AS returns
WITH collect({category: category, margin: margin, rating: rating, onTime: onTime, returns: returns}) AS rows
UNWIND [['Margin %', 'margin'], ['Rating (x20)', 'rating'], ['On-time %', 'onTime'], ['Returns (per 1000)', 'returns']] AS m
RETURN m[0] AS Metric,
       round([r IN rows WHERE r.category = 'Electronics' | r[m[1]]][0], 1) AS `Electronics`,
       round([r IN rows WHERE r.category = 'Home & Kitchen' | r[m[1]]][0], 1) AS `Home & Kitchen`,
       round([r IN rows WHERE r.category = 'Sports & Outdoors' | r[m[1]]][0], 1) AS `Sports & Outdoors`,
       round([r IN rows WHERE r.category = 'Books' | r[m[1]]][0], 1) AS `Books`,
       round([r IN rows WHERE r.category = 'Fashion' | r[m[1]]][0], 1) AS `Fashion`

reports.title: Supply flows
reports.query:
// Units flowing supplier -> warehouse -> customer region
MATCH (s:Supplier)-[r:SHIPS_TO]->(w:Warehouse)
RETURN s AS source, r AS flow, w AS target
UNION ALL
MATCH (w:Warehouse)-[r:SERVES]->(g:Region)
RETURN w AS source, r AS flow, g AS target

reports.title: Current parameter values
reports.query:
RETURN $neodash_category_name AS category, $neodash_contains_discount AS discount, $neodash_search AS search,
       toString($neodash_since) AS since, $neodash_segment AS segment, $neodash_country_name AS countries

reports.title: Orders matching all parameters
reports.query:
MATCH (cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[c:CONTAINS]->(p:Product)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(sub:Category)-[:SUBCATEGORY_OF]->(top:Category),
      (cu)-[:LIVES_IN]->(:City)-[:IN_COUNTRY]->(co:Country)
WHERE (coalesce($neodash_category_name, '') = '' OR $neodash_category_name IN [top.name, sub.name])
  AND ($neodash_contains_discount IS NULL OR toString($neodash_contains_discount) = '' OR c.discount = toFloat($neodash_contains_discount))
  AND (coalesce($neodash_search, '') = '' OR toLower(p.name) CONTAINS toLower($neodash_search) OR toLower(cu.name) CONTAINS toLower($neodash_search))
  AND ($neodash_since IS NULL OR $neodash_since = '' OR o.date >= $neodash_since)
  AND (coalesce($neodash_segment, '') = '' OR cu.segment = $neodash_segment)
  AND (size(coalesce($neodash_country_name, [])) = 0 OR co.name IN $neodash_country_name)
RETURN o.id AS Order, o.date AS Date, cu.name AS Customer, cu.segment AS Segment, co.name AS Country, p.name AS Product, c.quantity AS Qty, c.discount AS Discount
ORDER BY Date DESC LIMIT 200

reports.title: Matching revenue by category
reports.query:
MATCH (cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[c:CONTAINS]->(p:Product)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(sub:Category)-[:SUBCATEGORY_OF]->(top:Category),
      (cu)-[:LIVES_IN]->(:City)-[:IN_COUNTRY]->(co:Country)
WHERE (coalesce($neodash_category_name, '') = '' OR $neodash_category_name IN [top.name, sub.name])
  AND ($neodash_contains_discount IS NULL OR toString($neodash_contains_discount) = '' OR c.discount = toFloat($neodash_contains_discount))
  AND (coalesce($neodash_search, '') = '' OR toLower(p.name) CONTAINS toLower($neodash_search) OR toLower(cu.name) CONTAINS toLower($neodash_search))
  AND ($neodash_since IS NULL OR $neodash_since = '' OR o.date >= $neodash_since)
  AND (coalesce($neodash_segment, '') = '' OR cu.segment = $neodash_segment)
  AND (size(coalesce($neodash_country_name, [])) = 0 OR co.name IN $neodash_country_name)
RETURN top.name AS Category, toInteger(sum(c.quantity * c.unitPrice)) AS Revenue
